listing.name: Phase Shunt
listing.summary: Adds a hullmod for phase ships that functions like the shield shunt hullmod.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a hullmod for phase ships that functions like the shield shunt hullmod.

description:
Adds phase shunt hullmod that works just like the shield shunt one except for phase ships. There is a settings file to modify the values.

You can set it to a percentage or flat bonus for it and the bonus when S-modded.

Download:

https://gitlab.com/starsector/phase_shunt/-/archive/0.0.2/phase_shunt-0.0.2.zip

It should be unavailable to NPCs, so if is not installed on any ships you should be able to disable the mod.

aiDescription: Adds a hullmod for phase ships that functions like the shield shunt hullmod. It includes a settings file to modify values, allowing configuration of percentage or flat bonuses for the hullmod and its S-modded variant. The hullmod is intended to be unavailable to NPCs, allowing the mod to be disabled if not installed on any ships.
